faces.name: Vesuva
faces.oracleText: You may have this land enter tapped as a copy of any land on the battlefield.

faces.name: Vesuvan Doppelganger
faces.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it doesn't copy that creature's color and it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may have this creature become a copy of target creature, except it doesn't copy that creature's color and it has this ability."

faces.name: Vesuvan Drifter
faces.oracleText:
Flying
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
At the beginning of each combat, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you reveal a creature card this way, this creature becomes a copy of that card until end of turn, except it has flying.

faces.name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
faces.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single artifact or creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that artifact or creature, except it's not legendary.

faces.name: Vesuvan Mist
faces.oracleText:
Kicker {1}{B}
Return target nontoken, nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, conjure a duplicate of that card into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

faces.name: Vesuvan Shapeshifter
faces.oracleText:
As this creature enters or is turned face up, you may choose another creature on the battlefield. If you do, until this creature is turned face down, it becomes a copy of that creature, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may turn this creature face down."
Morph {1}{U}
